strings.autodrom.0.name: Start
strings.autodrom.0.goal: Readiness to move: fasten your seat belt, signal, and move off without delay on command.
strings.autodrom.0.how.0: Before the command, adjust the seat, head restraint and all three mirrors.
strings.autodrom.0.how.1: Fasten your seat belt. While you are at it, locate the hazard warning button and the indicator stalk with your eyes.
strings.autodrom.0.how.2: Start the engine. In a manual car: neutral and clutch pressed down; in an automatic: foot on the brake.
strings.autodrom.0.how.3: Switch on the left direction indicator - this is the ready signal.
strings.autodrom.0.how.4: On the “Start” command, move off smoothly without hesitation.
strings.autodrom.0.how.5: Cross the start line with the left indicator on, and switch it off immediately after the line.
strings.autodrom.0.how.6: After that, keep your speed no higher than the sign allows.
strings.autodrom.0.penalties.1: Start line crossed without the left direction indicator - 5 penalty points.
strings.autodrom.0.penalties.2: Indicator not switched off immediately after the line - penalty under the test ground methodology.
strings.autodrom.0.penalties.3: Delay in starting after the command - penalty; not moving off within 30 seconds - fail.
strings.autodrom.0.tip: In a manual car, practise moving off at the clutch biting point in advance, so that you do not stall from nerves at the start.
strings.autodrom.1.name: Stopping and moving off uphill
strings.autodrom.1.goal: Stop on a slope in the designated zone and move off uphill without rolling back.
strings.autodrom.1.how.0: Drive onto the slope smoothly, without accelerating.
strings.autodrom.1.how.1: Stop so that the car is inside the exercise zone: past the zone start line and without going onto the “Stop” line.
strings.autodrom.1.how.2: Apply the handbrake or hold the brake pedal firmly.
strings.autodrom.1.how.4: Manual: select first gear, add a little throttle and release the clutch slowly until the car starts to “squat” slightly and vibrate. Then lower the handbrake smoothly and keep releasing the clutch.
strings.autodrom.1.how.5: Automatic: move your foot from the brake to the accelerator quickly but smoothly. If the car rolls back, move off using the handbrake, releasing it as you press the accelerator.
strings.autodrom.1.penalties.1: Stopping outside the zone: not reaching the zone start line or going onto the “Stop” line - penalty.
strings.autodrom.1.penalties.2: Moving off less than 3 seconds after stopping - penalty.
strings.autodrom.1.penalties.3: Taking too long to move off after stopping - penalty under the test ground methodology.
strings.autodrom.1.tip: Count to yourself “one and, two and, three and, four”: this way you will certainly stand for more than 3 seconds without dragging it out.
strings.autodrom.2.name: Crossing a pedestrian crossing
strings.autodrom.2.goal: Stop before the pedestrian crossing at the “Stop” line, wait, and continue.
strings.autodrom.2.how.0: When you see the “Pedestrian crossing” sign and the road markings, reduce speed in good time.
strings.autodrom.2.how.1: Stop before the “Stop” line: without touching it and no more than 1 m from it.
strings.autodrom.2.how.3: If the diagram requires a turn after the crossing, switch on the indicator in advance.
strings.autodrom.2.penalties.0: Touching or crossing the “Stop” line - 25 penalty points.
strings.autodrom.2.penalties.1: Stopping more than 1 m from the “Stop” line - penalty.
strings.autodrom.2.penalties.2: Moving off less than 3 seconds later - penalty.
strings.autodrom.2.tip: In practice, note where the “Stop” line appears relative to the bonnet or side mirror when you are less than a metre from it. This is your reference point.
strings.autodrom.3.name: 90-degree turns
strings.autodrom.3.goal: Drive through a narrow corridor with right-angle turns to the left and right without touching the control lines with your wheels.
strings.autodrom.3.how.0: Minimum speed. Manual: first gear with the clutch partly pressed; automatic: creeping at idle with light braking.
strings.autodrom.3.how.1: Before a turn, position yourself closer to the outer side of the corridor: before a right turn, closer to the left line; before a left turn, closer to the right.
strings.autodrom.3.how.2: Do not start the turn early. Turn the wheel when the front wheels are almost level with the corner of the turn: the rear wheels follow a shorter arc and cut the corner.
strings.autodrom.3.how.3: Turn the wheel quickly, but let the car move slowly.
strings.autodrom.3.how.4: Coming out of the turn, straighten the wheel in good time and look where you want to go.
strings.autodrom.3.how.5: Watch the rear wheels in the side mirrors.
strings.autodrom.3.penalties.0: A wheel touching a control line - 20 penalty points for each touch.
strings.autodrom.3.penalties.1: You have 2 minutes for the exercise; exceeding the time is penalised.
strings.autodrom.3.tip: The most common mistake is turning too early: then the rear wheel touches the inner line.
strings.autodrom.4.name: Snake
strings.autodrom.4.goal: Drive through a winding corridor with alternating turns without touching the lines.
strings.autodrom.4.how.0: Drive very slowly and evenly, without jerks or unnecessary stops.
strings.autodrom.4.how.1: Look not at the bonnet but at the next bend of the corridor.
strings.autodrom.4.how.2: Begin turning the wheel a little later than feels natural, so that the rear wheels do not cut the arc.
strings.autodrom.4.how.3: Once past the apex of the arc, start turning the wheel the other way in good time.
strings.autodrom.4.how.4: Check the distance from the rear wheels to the lines in the side mirrors.
strings.autodrom.4.penalties.0: A wheel touching a control line - 20 penalty points for each touch.
strings.autodrom.4.penalties.1: You have 2 minutes for the exercise; exceeding the time is penalised.
strings.autodrom.4.tip: Slow speed gives you time to correct the steering. Two minutes is more than enough, so there is no need to hurry.
strings.autodrom.5.name: U-turn and parking
strings.autodrom.5.goal: Turn round in a confined space and reverse into the parking space so that the rear wheels reach the fixing line.
strings.autodrom.5.how.0: Take a comfortable starting position for the turn without touching the lines.
strings.autodrom.5.how.1: Turn round. If there is little room, do it in several moves: forward, back, forward again.
strings.autodrom.5.how.2: Select reverse and move at the lowest speed, looking in both side mirrors and over your shoulder.
strings.autodrom.5.how.3: Start turning the wheel when the rear of the car is level with the near edge of the parking space.
strings.autodrom.5.how.4: Straighten the car parallel to the side lines of the space, comparing the distance to them in the left and right mirrors.
strings.autodrom.5.how.5: Reverse until the rear wheels reach or cross the fixing line, then stop.
strings.autodrom.5.penalties.0: Rear wheels not reaching the fixing line - penalty.
strings.autodrom.5.penalties.1: A wheel touching a control line - 20 penalty points for each touch.
strings.autodrom.5.penalties.2: You have 2 minutes for the exercise; exceeding the time is penalised.
strings.autodrom.5.tip: If you feel the car going crooked, stop, drive forward a little and straighten up. An extra move costs less than touching a line.
strings.autodrom.6.name: Parallel reverse parking
strings.autodrom.6.goal: Reverse into a space along the kerb, put the right wheels on the fixing line and drive out.
strings.autodrom.6.how.0: Stop parallel to the parking space, about 1 m from its boundary, so that the rear bumper is slightly beyond the rear boundary of the space.
strings.autodrom.6.how.1: Select reverse and move back slowly.
strings.autodrom.6.how.2: When the rear boundary of the space is roughly level with the rear wheel (look in the right mirror), turn the wheel to the right.
strings.autodrom.6.how.3: When the car has turned about 45 degrees to the kerb, straighten the wheels and continue reversing in a straight line.
strings.autodrom.6.how.4: When the right front corner of the car passes the front boundary of the space, turn the wheel to the left to “bring in” the front of the car.
strings.autodrom.6.how.5: As soon as the car is parallel to the kerb, straighten the wheels and stop. Check in the right mirror that the right wheels are on the fixing line.
strings.autodrom.6.how.6: Driving out: left indicator, wheel to the left and smoothly forward, without touching the lines.
strings.autodrom.6.penalties.0: Right wheels not placed on the fixing line - penalty.
strings.autodrom.6.penalties.1: A wheel touching a control line - 20 penalty points for each touch.
strings.autodrom.6.penalties.2: You have 2 minutes for the exercise; exceeding the time is penalised.
strings.autodrom.6.tip: The exact reference points depend on the car model. Find out at your driving school which cars are used for the test at your specialised PSC, and practise on a similar one.
strings.autodrom.7.name: Crossing a controlled intersection
strings.autodrom.7.goal: Drive through the intersection according to the traffic light signals: stop at the “Stop” line on a stop signal, proceed without delay on a go signal, and signal your turn.
strings.autodrom.7.how.0: As you approach, switch on the direction indicator in advance if your route requires a turn.
strings.autodrom.7.how.1: On a stop signal, stop before the “Stop” line, without touching it and without stopping too far back.
strings.autodrom.7.how.2: On a go signal, move off immediately and drive through the intersection without unnecessary stops.
strings.autodrom.7.how.3: When turning, watch your path and do not go beyond the lines.
strings.autodrom.7.how.4: After the manoeuvre, switch the indicator off.
strings.autodrom.7.penalties.0: Driving through the intersection or crossing the “Stop” line on a stop signal - fail.
strings.autodrom.7.penalties.1: Taking too long to drive through on a go signal - penalty, and with a long delay, fail (under the test ground methodology).
strings.autodrom.7.penalties.2: Direction indicator not switched on when turning - penalty.
strings.autodrom.7.penalties.3: Stopping too far from the “Stop” line (under the test ground methodology, more than 1 m) - penalty.
strings.autodrom.7.tip: If the green light has been on for a while, be ready for it to change: approach so that you can stop calmly.
strings.autodrom.8.name: Crossing an uncontrolled level crossing
strings.autodrom.8.goal: Stop before the crossing at the “Stop” line, wait, make sure it is safe and cross.
strings.autodrom.8.how.0: When you see the level crossing signs, reduce speed.
strings.autodrom.8.how.1: Stop before the “Stop” line: without touching it and no more than 1 m from it.
strings.autodrom.8.how.2: Wait for at least 3 seconds and look left and right.
strings.autodrom.8.how.3: Drive over the level crossing without stopping on the tracks. In a manual car, do not change gear while crossing the rails: this reduces the risk of stalling.
strings.autodrom.8.penalties.0: Touching or crossing the “Stop” line before stopping - penalty.
strings.autodrom.8.penalties.1: Stopping more than 1 m from the “Stop” line - penalty.
strings.autodrom.8.penalties.2: Moving off less than 3 seconds after stopping - penalty.
strings.autodrom.8.tip: In real driving, look both ways before any level crossing and never stop on the tracks.
strings.autodrom.9.name: Acceleration lane
strings.autodrom.9.goal: Over a short section, show acceleration with an upshift, and then slowing down with a downshift.
strings.autodrom.9.how.0: After the minimum speed sign, accelerate to above 20 km/h.
strings.autodrom.9.how.1: Manual: while accelerating, shift from first to second gear within the section.
strings.autodrom.9.how.2: Before the maximum speed limit sign, reduce speed to 20 km/h or below.
strings.autodrom.9.how.3: Manual: shift back from second to first before the end of the section.
strings.autodrom.9.how.4: Automatic: simply accelerate and brake according to the signs; the gearbox changes gear.
strings.autodrom.9.penalties.0: Manual: the required gear not selected within the set section - penalty, one of the most “expensive” mistakes under the test ground methodology.
strings.autodrom.9.penalties.1: Sign requirements not met: not accelerating above the minimum speed or not slowing to the maximum speed - penalty.
strings.autodrom.9.tip: Practise the 1-2 and 2-1 shifts until you can do them without looking at the lever. The section is short and there is no time to think.
strings.autodrom.10.name: Emergency stop
strings.autodrom.10.goal: Stop instantly at an unexpected signal in the cabin and mark the stop with the hazard warning lights.
strings.autodrom.10.how.0: Be ready in this section: your right foot must be able to move to the brake quickly.
strings.autodrom.10.how.1: When you hear the sound signal or see the light signal in the cabin, brake at once to a full stop. In a manual car, press the clutch too.
strings.autodrom.10.how.2: Immediately after stopping, switch on the hazard warning lights.
strings.autodrom.10.how.3: Before continuing, switch the hazard warning lights off and only then move off.
strings.autodrom.10.penalties.0: Not stopping immediately after the signal or switching on the hazard lights late - penalty (under the test ground methodology, only a few seconds are allowed for each action).
strings.autodrom.10.penalties.1: Moving off without switching off the hazard warning lights - penalty.
strings.autodrom.10.tip: Find the hazard lights button at the start, while you are adjusting the mirrors. When the signal comes, there will be no time to look for it.
strings.autodrom.11.name: Finish
strings.autodrom.11.goal: Complete the test correctly: signal a right turn, cross the finish line, stop and leave the car.
strings.autodrom.11.how.0: Before the finish line, switch on the right direction indicator.
strings.autodrom.11.how.1: Cross the finish line and stop at the indicated place.
strings.autodrom.11.how.4: Apply the handbrake and switch off the engine.
strings.autodrom.11.how.5: Unfasten your seat belt and get out of the car.
strings.autodrom.11.penalties.0: Right direction indicator not switched on before the finish line - penalty.
strings.autodrom.11.penalties.1: If you reach 100 penalty points along the way, you will not get to the finish: the test is stopped early.
strings.autodrom.11.tip: The test is not over until you have crossed the finish line. Many people lose points on the last metres because of a forgotten indicator.
